name: Wine
overview: Scripture presents wine as a significant element in both daily life and spiritual contexts, as seen when Noah plants a vineyard and drinks wine (Genesis 9:20-21), illustrating its common use and potential for misuse. Wine appears in sacred settings, such as Melchizedek offering bread and wine as a priest of God (Genesis 14:18), and is associated with blessing and provision, exemplified by Isaac receiving wine during a meal (Genesis 27:25-28). These passages highlight wine's multifaceted role—from nourishment and celebration to its careful handling within God's covenant people.
